provenance.name: MIRDct normalized CTDI database
provenance.citation: Dinwiddie LE, Baggett JM, Kofler JM, et al. Survey of normalized CTDIvol values across four major computed tomography vendors for use in the MIRDct software. J Appl Clin Med Phys. 2026;27(2):e70473. doi:10.1002/acm2.70473
provenance.usage: CTDIvol = nctdi_w_mgy_per_100mas * (mAs_rot / 100) / pitch. The annex tabulates CTDIw at pitch 1.0, where CTDIw and CTDIvol coincide; CTDIw is pitch-independent, so the pitch division is applied by the caller.
provenance.collimation_note: Collimation is tabulated directly, so no over-beaming correction is applied to these values -- the collimation dependence is measured.
provenance.model_name_note: Model names are verbatim from the annex, including the source spellings 'Aquiliion ONE' and 'Defintion Edge'.
